properties.title: Modern Family Home
properties.description: A beautifully presented two-storey family home in the heart of Parramatta. Features include an open-plan kitchen and living area, four generous bedrooms, two modern bathrooms, and a double lock-up garage. The home is within walking distance of top-rated schools, parks, and public transport.

properties.title: City View Apartment
properties.description: Stunning high-rise apartment in Melbourne's CBD with breathtaking city skyline views from the glass balcony. Modern open-plan living, stone benchtops, and floor-to-ceiling windows. Walking distance to Southern Cross Station, Southbank, and Crown Casino. Available immediately.

properties.title: Brick Townhouse
properties.description: This charming red brick townhouse sits on a quiet street in the sought-after suburb of Newtown. Featuring three spacious bedrooms, two bathrooms, a private courtyard, and a single lock-up garage. Close to local cafes, Newtown Park, and bus routes into the Brisbane CBD.

properties.title: Luxury Waterfront Villa
properties.description: An exceptional waterfront villa offering resort-style living at its finest. This magnificent five-bedroom residence boasts panoramic ocean views, an infinity pool, a home theatre, and a gourmet kitchen. Situated on one of the Gold Coast's most prestigious addresses, this is a rare opportunity not to be missed.

properties.title: Studio Apartment
properties.description: A cozy and well-designed studio apartment in the vibrant suburb of Fremantle. The open-plan layout includes a modern kitchen, built-in wardrobe, and large windows that flood the space with natural light. Perfect for a single professional or student. Close to Fremantle Market and public transport.

properties.title: Perth Home
properties.description: A stunning single-storey contemporary home in the highly desirable suburb of Subiaco. Featuring three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a stylish open-plan living and dining area, and a spacious alfresco entertaining area. Just minutes from Subiaco Oval, cafes, boutique shops, and Kings Park.
